query:
insert into ElementIdents (
                        latest_collection,
                        product_id,
                        filepath,
                        file_hash,
                        definition_line,
                        ident,
                        source_hash
                    )
                    values (
                        $1,
                        $2,
                        $3,
                        $4,
                        $5,
                        $6,
                        $7
                    )
                    on conflict (
                        product_id,
                        filepath,
                        definition_line,
                        source_hash
                    ) do update
                    set
                        latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection,
                        file_hash = excluded.file_hash,
                        ident = excluded.ident
